rule:
ONLY the index below (test names, search aliases, category, body
systems, reference-body structures, and the gene of the measured protein or its synthesis
enzyme). Every explanation, interpretation and benchmark shown in the app is a verbatim
sentence from a licensed open text in the local library (StatPearls CC BY-NC-ND 4.0, NCBI
Bookshelf open-access books under their stated licences, OpenStax), with its source and
licence. Sentences are filed mechanically:
  - "benchmark": the sentence names the test and carries a number with a unit, %, a
    comparison sign, or the words sensitivity / specificity / cutoff / normal range;
  - "interpretation": names the test and says positive / indicates / suggests / elevated / low ...;
  - "about": names the test and says what it measures or how it is done.
Nothing is written or summarised by a model; numbers are as printed in the source.
Related tests: tests named in the same passage (co-mention count), a mechanical link.
Research: count of PMC OA library articles (data/research_library/pmc_oa, 4.6M complete open-access
articles) whose TITLE names the test in full, the newest systematic reviews / guidelines, and the newest
non-preclinical articles (title + PMCID), so newer and rarer tests show their current literature.
"Emerging" is a navigation label on newer or less routine tests, not an evidence grade.
Questionnaire items are copyrighted for many instruments and are NOT reproduced.
sources: StatPearls (CC BY-NC-ND 4.0), NCBI Bookshelf open-access books (licence per quote), OpenStax; research titles from PMC OA (sports library)
